I only pay when the thing is in my hand. Here I have to send the item price and the fee before anything happens, to a new page I've never heard of, and my cousin already lost a deposit exactly like that.

I buy to resell, so I count the landed cost per piece. 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% plus delivery makes every piece cost more than what I can find in Shorja, and there is nothing here for someone ordering in quantity.
